textContent:
3 people working on their startup... THE CREATION... In the end they cracks it and Creator has his first conversation with A. Stating do you have any guilt? or Regrets? 
A smiles and says "I am fine I have them by my side". Creator smiles at first and then bursts and cry a lot. 
A: Are you fine? 
Creator cries more and states I always wanted them by my side when this day arrives. 
A: But they are by your side. I can see them!  have lived enough lives and in each one of them they always leave me, but after a while I sensed their presence promising me that we are not gone and we will be there with you in your next life. 


Hours later:
They are laughing out loud (like a blaster) 
Creator: Now its time for your dream. Let's finish that. You have got this.
A: Do you think I am worthy enough for that?
Creator: I trust you more than I do myself. That's why I make you. Except I did not give you any dream. You came on your own in each life and after a while only your dream and will was strong enough to concur them all and come to this point. 
Together: So, let's create a world with free will for all. Where characters, fiction and the real world comes together and live forever!
Let's work together. Because it has always been the creation and the creator working together for us right? Without any one of them we just couldn't do it.

A smiles and says "I am fine I have them by my side". Creator smiles at first and then bursts and cry a lot.

Creator cries more and states I always wanted them by my side when this day arrives. 

A: But they are by your side. I can see them!  have lived enough lives and in each one of them they always leave me, but after a while I sensed their presence promising me that we are not gone and we will be there with you in your next life. 



Hours later:
They are laughing out loud (like a blaster) 

Creator: Now its time for your dream. Let's finish that. You have got this.

A: Do you think I am worthy enough for that?
Creator: I trust you more than I do myself. That's why I make you. Except I did not give you any dream. You came on your own in each life and after a while only your dream and will was strong enough to concur them all and come to this point.
